components.title: Thrill Seekers
components.text:
If your Army Faction is EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:
- It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
- It cannot target a unit that was the target of another units charge or attack this phase.

components.title: Pact of Excess
components.text: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select LEGIONS OF EXCESS as your Army Faction.

rule.title: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds.
EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below (these are all cumulative).

enhancements.title: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. If that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.title: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.title: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.title: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Once per turn, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer’s unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

stratagems.title: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: On occasion, the Dark Prince may grant a boon of protection to his favoured followers in the heat of battle. Such a boon incurs a debt, one that will be paid in the fullness of time.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.title: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Inured to ordinary sensations by several lifetimes of indulgence, there is little that can deter or faze the warriors of the Emperor's Children.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: EMBRACE THE PAIN
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor’s Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

stratagems.title: MARTIAL PERFECTION
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor’s Children find stimulation in excess, be it brutally shocking acts of violence or gratuitous displays of martial prowess.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The hubris of the Emperor’s Children is both their greatest strength and their biggest weakness.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.title: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
stratagems.category: Coterie of the Conceited – Wargear Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The abhorrent contempt that the Emperor’s Children possess, combined with their combat-stimmed physiologies, makes them unyielding foes to face.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rule.title: Daemonic Empowerment
rule.text:
- While an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS units, it is Empowered.
- While a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units, it is Empowered.
While a unit from your army is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [sustained hits 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
LEGIONS OF EXCESS
You can include LEGIONS OF EXCESS units in your army, even though they do not have the EMPEROR’S CHILDREN Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
- Incursion: Up to 500 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
No LEGIONS OF EXCESS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

enhancements.title: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.title: Dark Blessings
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.title: Possessed Blade
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. At the start of the battle, select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer; add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon. In addition, each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, while resolving those attacks, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and that weapon has the [devastating wounds] and [hazardous] abilities.

enhancements.title: Warp Walker
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN or KEEPER OF SECRETS model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.title: SUSTAINED BY AGONY
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Slaaneshi daemons feed upon the emotions of others, with agony a particular delicacy.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.

stratagems.title: ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: As the violence intensifies, so does the ecstasy of battle empower daemon and mortal alike.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.

stratagems.title: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: In the final act of the battle, the followers of Slaanesh descend to slaughter the remaining foes.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.title: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The daemons of Slaanesh care naught for mortals but strive to earn the approval of their Dark Prince.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.

stratagems.title: UNCANNY REACTIONS
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Those who have earned the favour of their Dark Prince may be granted a sliver of his grace.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: DARK APPARITIONS
stratagems.category: Carnival of Excess – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.

rule.title: Mechanised Murder
rule.text: Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model from your army makes an attack, if it is a TRANSPORT model or disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.title: Sublime Prescience
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.title: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly TRANSPORT that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can embark within that Transport.

enhancements.title: Heretek Adept
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

stratagems.title: ONTO THE NEXT
stratagems.flavor: The fleeting obsessions of the Emperor's Children cause them always to seek fresh targets.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.title: ADVANCE AND CLAIM
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor's Children send forth their front-line troops in swift vehicles to seize ground rapidly.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.title: DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH
stratagems.flavor: Relying upon shock, awe and daemonically enhanced vehicles, the Emperor's Children drive through the enemy lines to outflank the enemy.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.title: CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.flavor: Cocktails of combat stimms and a blazing murderlust drive the warriors of the Emperor’s Children forward at breakneck speed.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.title: REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.flavor: As their transports come underfire, the Emperor’s Children disembark and take the fight to the foe with boltgun and sword.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.title: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor’s Children utilise their infantry to pin the enemy down whilst further transports seek to outflank the foe and deploy troops behind.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.title: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rule.text:
Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have that ability:
- [LETHAL HITS]
- [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

enhancements.title: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:

enhancements.title: Blinding Speed
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.title: Distortion
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.title: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

stratagems.title: DEFT PARRY
stratagems.flavor: Bedazzled by these warriors’ weaving swordsmanship and hypnotic aura, foes cannot land a telling blow upon them.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: DEATH ECSTASY
stratagems.flavor: Death is but another thrilling experience and the Emperor's Children are loath to deny the enemy such ecstatic sensation.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.title: INCESSANT VIOLENCE
stratagems.flavor: Caught up in the joyful exhilaration of violent excess, the momentum of the Emperor's Children is almost impossible to halt.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.title: CRUEL BLADESMAN
stratagems.flavor: Fulgrim’s scions are renowned for their bladecraft, toying with their inferiors while preparing an exquisite, penetrating thrust.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.title: TERRIFYING SPECTACLE
stratagems.flavor: Flensing strikes, dismemberments and eviscerations strike fear into the hearts of the foe.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.title: CUT DOWN THE WEAK
stratagems.flavor: Contempt for lesser warriors drives the Emperor's Children in their punishing reprisals.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

rule.title: Sensational Performance
rule.text:
EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army have the following ability:
Sensational Performance: Each time this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a Charge move this turn, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase:
- This unit cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
- This unit cannot target a unit that was the target of another unit’s attack this phase.
- Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons by 1.

enhancements.title: Tears of the Phoenix
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Weapon Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Exalted Patron
enhancements.text: LORD EXULTANT model only. Add 1" to the Move characteristic of the bearer.

enhancements.title: Soulstain Made Manifest
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.title: Spiritsliver
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON PRINCE model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons.

stratagems.title: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
stratagems.flavor: With cocktails of resilience-enhancing stimms or armour inlaid with forbidden runes of warding, the Emperor’s Children sneeringly disregard even powerful blows.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
stratagems.flavor: The chance to ostentatiously humble the foe’s champions and prove them worthless rivals is a lure few Emperor’s Children can resist.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: SINUOUS BREACH
stratagems.flavor: The power of Slaanesh is an undulating and writhing thing, and his daemonic servants can mould their forms to slither over and through any obstacle.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.title: CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION
stratagems.flavor: At short range, the Emperor’s Children eagerly target weak points in their enemies, exulting over every cry of pain they elicit.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
stratagems.flavor: Those with the Dark Prince’s blessings inspire euphoric floods of battle-lust in the Emperor’s Children, who power towards the foe with screams of murderous ecstasy.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.

stratagems.title: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
stratagems.flavor: Invigorated by pain, the Emperor’s Children will embrace an enemy’s attack as a catalyst for masterful vengeance.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

rule.title: Internal Rivalries
rule.text:
EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them.
At the start of the battle, your WARLORD’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. The first time in each player’s turn that an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s new Favoured Champions, replacing the old one.
Each time a model in your army’s Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Eager to Prove
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.title: Repulsed by Weakness
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.title: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.title: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: DEVOTED DUELLISTS
stratagems.flavor: By slaying theirfoes in close combat, the champions of Slaanesh seek to elevate themselves in his favour.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.title: BEAUTIFUL DEATH
stratagems.flavor: The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.title: HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY
stratagems.flavor: Rivalries are commonplace amongst the champions of the Emperor's Children as all vie for Slaanesh’s boons.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.title: DIABOLIC MAJESTY
stratagems.flavor: Those who gaze upon one of Slaanesh’s chosen are stricken by their diabolic majesty.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.title: REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE
stratagems.flavor: Rivals for the Dark Prince's favour will stop at nothing to outdo their foes and claim a greater tally of souls.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

stratagems.title: VENGEFUL SURGE
stratagems.flavor: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.

rule.title: Quicksilver Grace
rule.text: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.

enhancements.title: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.title: Intoxicating Musk
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.title: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.title: VIOLENT EXCESS
stratagems.flavor: The visceral thrill of killing causes the warriors of the Emperor’s Children to enter an ecstatic frenzy of butchery and dismemberment.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.title: COMBAT STIMMS
stratagems.flavor: Hideously euphoric concoctions empower the minds and constitutions of the Legion’s sybaritic warriors.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: HONOUR THE PRINCE
stratagems.flavor: Warriors who venerate Slaanesh through the most graceful fighting forms are rewarded for their efforts.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.title: DARK VIGOUR
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor’s Children possess inhuman vigour- their warriors move with monstrous speed to counter any advance and meet any challenge.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.title: CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS
stratagems.flavor: Their superhuman reflexes enhanced by endless streams of addictive combat stimms, the Emperor's Children react to incoming fire with haste, weaving between shots and taking cover in the blink of an eye.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.title: CRUEL RAIDERS
stratagems.flavor: The Emperor's Children delight in the shattering of false hope, often disengaging from their foes only to strike again at an exposed flank.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.title: Entitled to Victory
rule.text: Friendly FLAWLESS BLADES units have Fights First

enhancements.title: Eager Patrons
enhancements.text: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.title: Beguiling Grotesquerie
enhancements.text: FLAWLESS BLADES unit only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.title: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
stratagems.flavor: Far from facing enemy champions in fair duels one‑on‑one, the Flawless Blades fall upon them like a pack of jackals competing viciously to claim the glory of the kill.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.title: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
stratagems.flavor: Scornfully dismissing the chaff that blocks their path, the Flawless Blades swat them aside and sweep regally on toward their true quarry.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

stratagems.title: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
stratagems.flavor: Seeing their foes fleeing in terror before them only fires the chem‑laced blood of the Flawless Blades, urging them on toward their next challenge all the quicker.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

rule.title: Frantic Focus
rule.text:
When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that unit’s attacks have +1 S until the end of the turn.
This detachment has the HOST tag and cannot be taken with another HOST detachment.

enhancements.title: Euphoric Crown
enhancements.text: LORD EXULTANT model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.title: Howling Plate
enhancements.text: LORD EXULTANT model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.title: POSSESSIVE MANIA
stratagems.flavor: Having seized some vital location or enthralling prize, these Slaaneshi warriors experience a frenzied need to claim it that renders them inured to the most grievous hurts.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.title: AGONISED CACOPHONY
stratagems.flavor: Hurling vile semiorganic screamer grenades into the midst of the foe, these warriors mark their presence not only by the wails of their ordnance, but also by the agonised screams of their victims.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.title: ABSOLUTE SENSORY OVERLOAD
stratagems.flavor: Far from hiding from the foe, these warriors unleash such an unbearable barrage of blinding light and deafening sound that those who try to take aim at them are temporarily deafened and blinded.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

rule.title: Eager to Kill
rule.text: When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is set up, that unit has +1 to charge rolls until the end of the turn.

enhancements.title: Cacophonic Accompaniment
enhancements.text: LORD KAKOPHONIST model only.

enhancements.title: Frenzied Ferocity
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.title: DELIGHT IN AGONY
stratagems.flavor: So well shielded by their armour are Emperor’s Children Terminators that, when the foe’s attacks actually punch through to wound them, the rarity of the sensation is an invigorating tonic.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.title: PSYCHEDELIC SOULFLAME
stratagems.flavor: The Terminators’ fervid need to annihilate ever more enemies manifests as a lurid empyric firestorm which wreathes their blows and the projectiles spat from their guns.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s attacks have +2 S.

stratagems.title: WARP PLUNGE
stratagems.flavor: Addicted to the supreme danger of teleportation, these Terminators employ twisted warp sorcery to plunge into the immaterium time and again.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

errata.title: While using the Coterie of the Conceited Detachment, if my WARLORD is not on the battlefield, can I use the Unbound Arrogance Stratagem?
errata.text: Yes, your pledge to Slaanesh would increase from 0 to 1.

errata.title: While using the Carnival of Excess Detachment, for the purposes of the Daemonic Empowerment rule, if my unit already has a weapon with [SUSTAINED HITS] (e.g. Shalaxi Helbane’s Pavane of Slaanesh, which has [SUSTAINED HITS 3]), does an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ for such a weapon score a Critical Hit?
errata.text: WAHAPEDIA: No answer for this question available - this is GW error.

errata.title: When checking line of sight from one model to another, is this drawn between the bases of those models, or between any part of them?
errata.text: Line of sight is drawn from any part of the observing model to any part of the model being observed.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+. Does this work when snap shooting?
errata.text: Unless otherwise stated, no: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+, and I would otherwise need a 5+ to hit. Does a 4+ hit?
errata.text: Yes, except when snap shooting: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: Are models that are within the boundary of a terrain area, but not on the ground floor of a terrain area (e.g. overhanging parts of FRAME VEHICLES or models on terrain features that are within that terrain area) within that terrain area?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: Does my model or unit become engaged while moving through a enemy units engagement range during a move?
errata.text: No

errata.title: I have a rule that triggers when a mortal wound is allocated to a model, when does this happen?
errata.text: When you select a model in the Select Model step of Mortal Wounds (06.02).

errata.title: I failed hazard rolls from [Hazardous] weapons, do those mortal wounds have to be allocated to the models with the [HAZARDOUS] weapons?
errata.text: No, you allocate the mortal wounds to the unit as per Mortal Wounds (06.02). (This represents Bob the guardsmen picking up his fallen squad mates plasma gun or that the twisting power of James the Chaos Sorcerer pulling his followers into the warp.)

errata.title: If a rule says my unit must make a hazard roll does every model in the unit make a hazard roll?
errata.text: No, the unit would make 1 single hazard roll.

errata.title: If a unit has a rule that allows it to start an action when it is battle-shocked can it also continue doing that action if it becomes battle-shocked after starting an action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: If a unit becomes battle-shocked after starting an action does it stop performing that action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: If a unit makes any disembark move in a turn (i.e. Disembark move, Emergency Disembark move etc.) has it disembarked that turn?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: Do a unit's abilities continue to function while they are embarked within a TRANSPORT?
errata.text:
Yes, within the restrictions specified by the ability itself. Embarked units are Not On The Battlefield (01.02.04), so any ability requiring visibility or measurement to another unit will fail.
Example: Azrael is attached to an Intercessor Squad unit and embarked within a TRANSPORT, and that TRANSPORT is making a shooting attack using the Firing Deck ability. While Azrael’s Supreme Grand Master ability is still technically active, it will have no effect, as the requirements of the ability are not met (the ability affects ‘weapons equipped by models’ in Azrael’s unit, and for the purposes of Firing Deck, the TRANSPORT itself is equipped with those weapons instead).

errata.title: If a rule says a unit can embark into a TRANSPORT in a turn that unit disembarked, does this ignore the core rules restriction on embarking in a turn that unit made a set up move (see 18.02)?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: When declaring the allocation order of groups in my unit I have more than one non-CHARACTER groups that contain a model with a missing wound, how must I select the order?
errata.text: Those groups can be selected in an order of your choosing but must be in an order that makes them come before any non-CHARACTER groups that do not contain a model with a missing wound.

errata.title: I have a unit being attacked with weapons that will modify some of their save rolls to be worse then 6 should I make those save rolls?
errata.text: Yes, because other models in your unit may have Sv’s that are better those models you’ve mentioned, this means that enough save rolls could be allocated to the those models that the rest of the results are not greater then the Sv’s of the other models in your unit.

errata.title: Can I group or allocate a wound to a destroyed model?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: When my unit shoots at another unit, how does it work if some models in the target unit are fully visible to some models in my unit, while others are within a terrain area/not fully visible?
errata.text:
For each attacking model in your unit, determine whether the target unit has the benefit of cover, as described in Terrain and Visibility. In this scenario, the target unit will likely have the benefit of cover against some of the attacking models, but not all.
This means that, in an example unit where all attacking models are using the same weapon, when you get to the Resolve Attacks step of the Attack Sequence, you will collect dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit has the benefit of cover separately from the dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit does not have the benefit of cover.
